title: Electricity Relationship Reduction on Residential Natural Gas Supply Re-Contracts
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Natural Gas Supply re-contract after rollover, the electricity relationship reduction depends on the customer's Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply agreement: 0.0150 per therm when that agreement is active and its service start date is 1461 or more calendar days before the election date, 0.0075 per therm when it is active and its service start date is at least 730 but fewer than 1461 calendar days before the election date, and no reduction when the customer has no active electricity agreement or its service began fewer than 730 days before. The reduction lowers the re-contract rate by that amount per therm.

The records read are the status and the service start date of the customer's Residential Electricity Supply agreement.

| Residential Electricity Supply agreement status | Calendar days from its service start date to the election date | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|---|
| active | 1461 or more | 0.0150 |
| active | 730 to 1460 | 0.0075 |
| active | fewer than 730 | none |
| not active, or no electricity agreement | any | none |

### Cases (hypothetical customers)

- Electricity service started 1 March 2021 and is active; election date 1 March 2025: 1461 days, reduction 0.0150.
- Electricity agreement active for 1460 days on the election date: reduction 0.0075.
- Electricity agreement active for 729 days: no reduction.
- Electricity agreement closed after a switch to another supplier, whatever its start date: no reduction.
